title: Elf o Karu Monotachi II
native_title: エルフを狩るモノたちⅡ
overview:
Answering your calls for an encore... back on the Sega Saturn once again!

Includes a bonus disc featuring popular voice actors!

Elf o Karu Monotachi II is an adventure game based on the anime and the sequel to the first Saturn game. Junpei, Airi, Ritsuko and the elf sorceress Celcia are still hunting for the spell fragments, marked on the skin of elves, that can send the travelers home to Japan. The story of the anime is told in full, and at key moments you pick what happens next from a list of choices - some of them leading to actions that never happened on TV.

- Two discs: the game plus a bonus disc with the voice cast
- Memory backup save
